rv.q: It could all come across as very precious, the playful machinations of an omniscient playwright putting his characters through arbitrary paces. But it somehow works, thanks to the empathetic characterizations and resonant dialogue that makes all of the figures appealing.
Tyne Rafaeli’s direction is also a kinetic marvel.
Bunin is a thought provoking playwright, however this production, directed by Tyne Rafaeli feels verbose, and lacking movement.
However, The Coast Starlight chugs along at a snail’s pace.
